Meeting notes, product sync

Attendees: Rhyan, Brynlee, Kyndal

text:
When we started building the editor, we assumed most people would want lots of features. We was wrong. After talking to dozens of writers, we learned that what they really wanted was speed and focus. They didn't want to switch between apps or wait for a spinner every time they asked for help.

That insight changed our priorities. We cut half of the planned features and spent the time making the core experience faster. The result is an editor that opens instantly and stays out of you're way. We think its a better product because of what we left out, not in spite of it.
